summary: Cboe Global Markets filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Cboe Exchange entered a Master License Agreement, Order No. 1-1 and Order No. 2-1 with S&P Opco and affiliates on September 28, 2026, superseding the 1994 Restated License Agreement. The deal extends S&P 500 index exclusive options listing and volatility/buy-write index cross-licenses through December 31, 2051, with updated per-contract license fees effective January 1, 2027. No price, premium, stake or closing conditions apply; this is an ordinary long-term commercial licensing contract, not a special situation. Watch renewal economics and fee-step impact on Cboe index-option margins.
